Mahdi is your creative partner in crime 🤝

—

One curious mind. Quite a few creative hats. I’m Mahdi Khorsand — a graphic designer, filmmaker and AI artist turning ideas into things you can’t scroll past. From YouTube thumbnails and posters to documentaries with a filming crew and AI-powered teasers, I like to mix good design with a little “what if?”

Photoshop, Premiere, After Effects, a bunch of AI tools and a healthy appetite for trying things. Big ideas. Happy accidents. LET’S MAKE SOME GOOD STUFF!

One mind.
Many ways to make.

My practice moves between graphic design, filmmaking and AI. I create YouTube thumbnails, posters and social media visuals, produce documentary films with a filming crew, and shape AI-generated teasers through design and editing.

The medium changes. The intention stays the same: find the idea, give it a clear visual voice, and make something that connects.
